column3: n. 外壳, 皮, 无价值之物;vt. 剥...的壳, 削皮
column5: The corn's outer husk protects the kernels from insects and rain.
column6: 玉米外层的苞叶保护籽粒免受虫害和雨水侵袭。

column3: a. 有益的, 有用的, 有益健康的;适于健康的
column5: The bank's collapse had a salutary effect on lending standards nationwide.
column6: 银行倒闭对全国的放贷标准产生了有益的警示作用。

column3: n. 祖先, 祖宗
column5: Her forebears arrived with nothing and built a shipping business within a generation.
column6: 她的先辈们身无分文地到来,一代人之内建起了航运生意。

column3: a. 永久的, 持久的, 不变的
column5: His abiding love of mountains led him to train as a mountain guide.
column6: 他对山的持久热爱使他成为了一名登山向导。

column3: n. 暗示, 微微觉得
column5: She had no inkling that the interview would last three full hours.
column6: 她完全没想到面试竟然持续了整整三个小时。

column3: a. 失去知觉的, 没生命的, 无精打采的;无生命的, 无生机的
column5: The animation gives inanimate objects like teapots and clocks vivid personalities.
column6: 这部动画赋予了茶壶和时钟等无生命物体鲜明的个性。

column3: n. 喧闹;v. 大声地要求

column6: 降低房价的呼声贯穿了整晚的市议会会议。

column3: a. 易怒的, 爱挑剔的, 难取悦的, 易烦恼的
column5: The fussy client rejected five design drafts before approving the final logo.
column6: 挑剔的客户否掉了五稿设计,才批准了最终标识。

column3: a. 神秘的, 含义模糊的, 隐藏的;隐蔽的
column5: The detective studied the cryptic note found beside the empty display case.
column6: 侦探研究着空展柜旁那张神秘难解的字条。

column3: a. 统治的；在位的；本届的；起支配作用的
column5: The reigning champion defended her title with a masterful final round.
column6: 卫冕冠军以精彩的最后一轮保住了头衔。

column3: n. 敏捷, 灵活, 机敏
column5: The obstacle course tests a dog's agility, speed, and concentration.
column6: 障碍赛考验狗的敏捷、速度和专注力。

column3: a. 柔软的, 逢迎的, 顺从的;vt. 使柔软, 使顺从
column5: Daily stretching keeps the dancers' bodies supple and injury-resistant.
column6: 每日拉伸让舞者身体柔韧,不易受伤。

column3: n. 坚硬, 僵化, 坚硬, 刚性, 刚度;刚度系数
column5: The coach criticized the team's tactical rigidity after three straight defeats.
column6: 三连败后,教练批评了球队战术上的僵化。

column3: a. 狡诈的, 诡计多端的, 巧妙的
column5: The crafty old negotiator let the silence do most of the talking.
column6: 老练狡黠的谈判高手大多时候让沉默替他说话。

column3: a. 安抚的, 和好的, 调和的
column5: The mayor struck a conciliatory tone when addressing the angry residents.
column6: 市长对愤怒的居民讲话时语气带着安抚。

column3: a. 地下的, 秘密的;n. 地下室, 地下工作者
column5: Engineers completed the subterranean tunnel after six years of careful excavation.
column6: 经过六年细致开挖,工程师们完成了这条地下隧道。

column3: n. 烟, 水蒸气, 臭气散发;vi. 冒烟, 发臭气, 散发
column5: The alley would reek of garbage by late afternoon in summer.
column6: 夏天每到傍晚,这条小巷就散发着垃圾的恶臭。

column3: n. 管理人, 保管人, 监护人;保管人, 管理人
column5: The school custodian unlocks the gates at six every winter morning.
column6: 学校管理员每天冬季早晨六点打开大门。

column3: vt. 厌恶, 憎恨
column5: She detests sales calls so much that she lets unknown numbers ring.
column6: 她非常讨厌推销电话,陌生来电一律不接。

column3: vi. 冒泡, 沸腾;vt. 使煮沸, 使浸透
column5: The sidelined players would seethe silently on the bench after every substitution.
column6: 每次换人后,坐冷板凳的球员都在暗中憋着火。

column3: a. 矮胖的, 健壮结实的
column5: The stocky porter carried two suitcases up five flights without pausing.
column6: 敦实的搬运工拎着两个行李箱上五层楼,中途都不歇脚。

column3: a. 美味的, 好吃的, 可口的;适口的, 味美的
column5: The chef made the healthy menu more palatable with herbs instead of salt.
column6: 厨师用香草代替盐,让健康菜单更可口。

column3: n. 喷射, 冲刺;vt. 喷射
column5: A sudden spurt of growth left the boy needing new trousers again.
column6: 男孩突然蹿个儿,又需要买新长裤了。

column3: a. 不动的, 不变的, 固定的, 静止的
column5: The injured climber stayed immobile until the rescue helicopter arrived.
column6: 受伤的登山者一动不动地等待救援直升机到达。

column3: vi. 激动, 感到刺痛, 抖动;vt. 使感刺痛
column5: My fingers would tingle after twenty minutes in the freezing wind.
column6: 在寒风里待上二十分钟,我的手指就会发麻刺痛。

column3: a. 发热的, 极度兴奋的, 不安的
column5: The editors worked at a feverish pace to meet the dawn deadline.
column6: 编辑们以狂热的速度赶工,要在黎明前交稿。

column3: n. 手风琴;a. 可折叠的
column5: Street musicians played accordion tunes while tourists shopped for leather goods.
column6: 街头艺人演奏着手风琴曲,游客们在挑选皮具。

column3: n. 脱水;脱水; 脱水作用

column6: 徒步者多带水,以防在无遮蔽的山脊上脱水。

column3: a. 现存的, 未毁的
column5: Only three extant copies of the first edition survive in public libraries.
column6: 第一版仅存三册,收藏于公共图书馆。

column3: n. 租船人, 承运人, 托运人, 货船, 运输机;装货人, 货主, 承运人
column5: The container freighter left the harbor before dawn to catch the tide.
column6: 集装箱货船赶在黎明前趁着潮水离港。
